import re

NODE = re.compile(r'^([A-Z][A-Z_]+)(?: (.*))?$')
NS = re.compile(r'^namespace(?: (\S+))? href=(.*)$')
KV = re.compile(r'^(\w+)=(.*)$')
NAMED = ('ELEMENT', 'ATTRIBUTE', 'ENTITY_REF', 'PI', 'ENTITY_DECL', 'DTD', 'ELEMDECL', 'ATTRDECL')

def parse(lines):
    doc = {}
    doclines = []
    nodes = []
    nlines = []
    ns = []
    nslines = []
    stack = []
    cur = None
    elem_path = ''
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        if not l.strip():
            continue
        ind = len(l) - len(l.lstrip(' '))
        d = ind // 2
        s = l[ind:]
        if s.startswith('content='):
            if cur is not None:
                cur['content'] = s[len('content='):]
                nlines.append(i)
            continue
        m = NS.match(s)
        if m:
            ns.append({'element': elem_path, 'prefix': m.group(1) or '', 'href': m.group(2)})
            nslines.append(i)
            continue
        m = NODE.match(s)
        if m:
            typ = m.group(1)
            rest = m.group(2) or ''
            if typ in NAMED:
                name = rest
                flags = ''
            else:
                name = ''
                flags = rest
            if typ in ('DOCUMENT', 'HTML_DOCUMENT'):
                label = ''
            elif typ == 'ELEMENT':
                label = name
            elif typ == 'ATTRIBUTE':
                label = '@' + name
            else:
                label = typ.lower() + '()'
            stack = stack[:d]
            stack.append(label)
            path = '/'.join(stack) or '/'
            if typ == 'ELEMENT':
                elem_path = path
            cur = {'line': i, 'depth': d, 'type': typ, 'name': name, 'flags': flags, 'path': path, 'content': ''}
            nodes.append(cur)
            nlines.append(i)
            continue
        m = KV.match(s)
        if m and d == 0:
            doc[m.group(1)] = m.group(2)
            doclines.append(i)
            continue
        if cur is not None and cur['content'] != '':
            cur['content'] += '\n' + l
            nlines.append(i)
    blocks = []
    if doc:
        blocks.append({'name': 'document', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': doclines, 'records': [doc]})
    if nodes:
        blocks.append({'name': 'nodes', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': nlines, 'records': nodes})
    if ns:
        blocks.append({'name': 'namespaces', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': nslines, 'records': ns})
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': []}
